fusions.name: Turned Venom
fusions.desc: Flicks a bead of venom that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to turn it against its allies for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Whose Fault
fusions.desc: Lashes every enemy within 4 tiles, which deals 26 damage, always as a critical hit, and leaves each [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Each has a 40% chance to turn against its allies for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Feigned Death
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Never Where Expected
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
